sources.title: Qwen3-0.6B - Qualcomm AI Hub
sources.snippet: Qwen3-0.6B State‑of‑the‑art large language model useful on a variety of language understanding and generation tasks. The Qwen3‑0.6B is a state‑of‑the‑art multilingual language model with 0.6 billion parameters, excelling in language understanding, generation, coding, and mathematics.

sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Abstract In this work, we present Qwen3, the latest version of the Qwen model family. Qwen3 comprises a series of large language models (LLMs) designed to advance performance, efficiency, and multilingual capabilities. sources.title: Jinx-org/Jinx-Qwen3-0.6B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Model Description Jinx is a "helpful-only" variant of popular open-weight language models that responds to all queries without safety refusals. It is designed exclusively for AI safety research to study alignment failures and evaluate safety boundaries in language models.
